description: Chief Secretariate - Southern Province - Rules of the Statute of the Registration of Trading Places No. 04 of 2019 under the Southern Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the revision and republication of a specimen form related to the Registration of Trading Places statute. It deals with regulatory compliance and corrections to a previously published legal form, falling under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, or other specialized categories.
